camera.motion: static (phase-correlation background shift vs frame 0 < 0.15 px in every frame; scripts/camera_shift.py)
camera.perspective_cues: camera roughly level at about table height+, looking slightly down at a square wooden table seen obliquely (front edge runs from (210,540) to (1140,595), far edge ~y 455-465). Ball moves right->left and toward the camera (apparent diameter grows 20 -> ~30-35 px).

objects.name: ball
objects.desc: small white ping-pong-type ball, the only moving object besides the person's arm

apparent_diameter_px.note: mask width across main axis (blur-insensitive); mask = pixels brighter than ~half way between wall and ball

objects.name: person
objects.desc: woman in denim overalls and black top, face blurred, standing behind the table right of centre; tosses the ball with her right hand (image-left hand side at x~820)

extent_frame0_px.y_bottom: cut by image bottom (720); legs partly hidden by table 540-620

objects.hand_position: holds ball at (822,375) frames 0-6, lowers it to (819,386) by frame 11, swings forward/left and releases between frames 13 and 14 near (783,345)

objects.name: white_cup
objects.desc: tall white tumbler/cup on the table, right of centre, just left of the person's hand

objects.name: card_tent
objects.desc: two playing cards leaned together (card house) between tape roll and cup; first bounce surface

objects.name: flat_cards
objects.desc: playing cards lying flat in front of the card tent

objects.name: tape_roll
objects.desc: translucent pale-yellow roll of packing tape lying flat; second bounce surface

objects.name: glass_jar

objects.name: dark_card
objects.desc: dark navy card/phone lying near the table front with a yellow sticky note on it

objects.name: table
